examples.arabic: بابا فكر شوي وقال لازم نلاقي حل سريع للحمة والخضرة
examples.english: Dad thought a bit and said we need to find a quick solution for the meat and vegetables.
examples.transliteration: Baba fakkar shway w qal lazim nlaqi hall saree' lal lahme w el khodra.

examples.arabic: كريم قال بدي ابعتلك صورنا عن طريق برنامج جديد سريع كتير بس ليلى ما فهمت الفكرة
examples.english: Karim said, "I want to send you our photos through a new, very fast app," but Layla didn't understand the idea.
examples.transliteration: Karim qāl biddī ab'atlik suwarnā 'an ṭarīq barnāmij jdīd sarī' ktīr bass Layla mā fahmit al-fikra.
